description: Feature contract reconstructed from NLP_by_Vamshi_DL_updated.ipynb and Dataset/benchmark_results.csv. This model predicts the benchmark Execution_Success label after SQL generation/execution context is available.

preprocessing.text: lowercase; remove non-ASCII letters; NLTK English stopword removal; WordNet noun lemmatization; join processed text columns in source order
preprocessing.numeric: saved StandardScaler from scaler.pkl; transform numeric columns in manifest order
preprocessing.concatenation: sparse hstack(text features, scaled numeric features), then float32 dense array
preprocessing.sequence_models: reshape to (batch, features, 1) for CNN/LSTM/GRU/BiGRU; DNN uses (batch, features)

limitations: Expected_SQL, Generated_SQL, row counts and match metrics are post-generation/post-execution features.
This adapter is not suitable for pre-execution prediction or for requests that only contain a natural-language query.
The saved scaler includes QueryID because that is how the original notebook builds its numeric feature matrix; preserve this for parity until the models are retrained with a redesigned feature set.
